record.field: Tooling Components: variant sales description and documents

# Variant Sales Description: field, backend forms, retired SEO Description, printed documents. # Requested by Dale on 7 and 9 October 2026. Identical in rbc_industrial_theme and tooling_components_theme: # every record below has a fixed key, so whichever theme runs last simply refreshes the same records. Fields = env['ir.model.fields'].sudo() View = env['ir.ui.view'].sudo().with_context(active_test=False) KEY = 'liber_variant_docs.' # 1. the field (text, translatable, one per variant) HELP = ('Brand-specific text for this variant (for example Raymond or Bordignon). Shown on the website product page ' 'under the product Sales Description, which stays visible, and printed on the delivery slip.') fld = Fields.search([('model', '=', 'product.product'), ('name', '=', 'x_variant_description')], limit=1) if not fld: Fields.create({'model_id': env.ref('product.model_product_product').id, 'name': 'x_variant_description', 'field_description': 'Variant Sales Description', 'ttype': 'text', 'translate': True, 'help': HELP}) elif fld.field_description != 'Variant Sales Description' or fld.help != HELP: fld.write({'field_description': 'Variant Sales Description', 'help': HELP}) REPORT = [] def upsert(key, vals): view = View.search([('key', '=', key)], limit=1) vals = dict(vals, key=key, active=True) if view: view.write(vals) else: view = View.create(vals) return view def hook(key, vals, archs, label): """Create or refresh one extension view with the first arch that fits its parent. Each attempt runs in a savepoint, so a parent view that differs from standard Odoo (another module or a customised report) never breaks the import: that document is skipped and the reason recorded.""" for n, arch in enumerate(archs): sp = env.cr.savepoint() try: upsert(key, dict(vals, arch=arch)) sp.close(rollback=False) REPORT.append('%s: ok (anchor %s of %s)' % (label, n + 1, len(archs))) return True except Exception as e: sp.close(rollback=True) env.invalidate_all(flush=False) last = str(e).splitlines()[0][:160] if str(e) else 'error' old = View.search([('key', '=', key)], limit=1) if old: sp = env.cr.savepoint() try: old.write({'active': False}) sp.close(rollback=False) except Exception: sp.close(rollback=True) env.invalidate_all(flush=False) REPORT.append('%s: SKIPPED, no matching place in the parent view (%s)' % (label, last)) return False # 2. the field on the variant forms (Sales > Products > Product Variants, and the variant pop-up) FORM_ARCH = ('' '') for parent_xmlid, vkey in (('product.product_normal_form_view', 'x_variant_description_form'), ('product.product_variant_easy_edit_view', 'x_variant_description_easy')): parent = env.ref(parent_xmlid, raise_if_not_found=False) if not parent: continue old = View.search([('key', '=', 'website_variant_desc.' + vkey)], limit=1) # created by earlier versions if old: old.write({'key': KEY + vkey}) hook(KEY + vkey, {'name': 'Variant Sales Description', 'type': 'form', 'model': 'product.product', 'mode': 'extension', 'inherit_id': parent.id, 'priority': 99}, [FORM_ARCH, FORM_ARCH.replace('//sheet', '//form')], 'variant form ' + vkey) # 3. SEO Description removed from every product form and list, for everyone (developer mode included): # the website and documents use the Sales Description and the Variant Sales Description only, so a # third description field would only cause inconsistency. The stored text is NOT deleted: it stays in the # database and in Export, so it can still be moved into Variant Sales Description. for model_name in ('product.template', 'product.product'): if model_name not in env or 'seo_description' not in env[model_name]._fields: continue hosts = View.search([('model', '=', model_name), ('type', 'in', ('form', 'tree', 'list')), ('arch_db', 'like', 'seo_description'), ('key', 'not like', KEY + '%')]) for host in hosts: arch = host.arch_db or '' if 'name="seo_description"' not in arch and "name='seo_description'" not in arch: continue hide = 'column_invisible' if host.type in ('tree', 'list') else 'invisible' xp = ['' '1' % hide] if 'for="seo_description"' in arch or "for='seo_description'" in arch: xp.append('' '1') hook(KEY + 'hide_seo_%s' % host.id, {'name': 'SEO Description removed', 'type': host.type, 'model': model_name, 'mode': 'extension', 'inherit_id': host.id, 'priority': 999}, ['%s' % ''.join(xp), '%s' % xp[0]], 'hide SEO Description in view %s' % host.id) # 4. printed documents: the brand, and on the delivery slip also the Variant Sales Description. # Odoo leaves the brand out of the product name when a product has only one brand # (for example XH012: Bordignon only), so it is printed on its own line. LINES_ARCH = '''
:
''' LINES_OK = hook(KEY + 'lines', {'name': 'Variant brand and description (documents)', 'type': 'qweb'}, [LINES_ARCH], 'shared lines template') # Candidate anchors per document, most specific first. Product expressions are guarded, so an anchor that # lands in a cell where the variable does not exist prints nothing instead of failing at print time. for vkey, parent_xmlid, product_expr, with_desc, skip_expr, xpaths in (DOCS if LINES_OK else []): parent = env.ref(parent_xmlid, raise_if_not_found=False) if not parent: REPORT.append('%s: not installed here' % vkey) continue sets = '' % ( product_expr.replace('"', '"'), with_desc, (skip_expr or 'False').replace('"', '"')) archs = ['%s' % ( xp.replace('"', '"'), sets) for xp in xpaths] hook(KEY + vkey, {'name': 'Variant brand on documents (%s)' % vkey, 'type': 'qweb', 'mode': 'extension', 'inherit_id': parent.id, 'priority': 99}, archs, vkey) # What happened, readable without logs: Settings > Technical > System Parameters > liber_variant_docs.report env['ir.config_parameter'].sudo().set_param('liber_variant_docs.report', ' | '.join(REPORT))
